correctness.rationale: Exact bond-cancellation gives ΔH/J=(c-d)[(1-r)(b-e)+r(a-f)] for all six-spin windows. Exhaustive symbolic sign analysis proves only r=1/2 and r=1 are positive transition values. The explicit 32-word directed transfer matrix gives B_n=tr(T^n) for n≥6. Reversal symmetry splits it into two 16-dimensional integer blocks with exact characteristic polynomials verified by constructing and computing determinants from their public formula. Dominant components are primitive and unique (sizes 22,22,22,32,28), which makes the identified even-sector positive root the simple leading eigenvalue. Perron asymptotics, strict entries at r=1 and rigorous algebraic root intervals prove the five regimes and maximum. The full characteristic polynomials give the exact two-state parity correction at r=1/2. Replayed standalone verification checks symbolic certificates, all six-pattern energy identities, and independently all length-6..12 configurations. No finite enumeration is substituted for the all-size proof.

originality.rationale: The closest primary 2016 paper treats the identical positive J1-J2 Kawasaki Hamiltonian and distinguishes r=1/2 and r=1, but it enumerates dynamically selected M-state families whose neutral exchange paths can produce subsequent downhill moves. The present five-regime law enumerates all one-step non-downhill-swap configurations, a larger class with equal-coupling rate 1.8023925656 rather than the Table 2 kinetic rate 1.4655. Older 2002 work treats J2=0 only. Exact claim and implication comparisons, published-record aliases, and accessible own ledger were checked. Remaining risk is earlier unindexed or differently worded literature; novelty is not claimed to be independently certified.

value.rationale: All one-step conservative energy minima constitute a standard well-defined landscape statistic distinct from actual kinetic traps when zero-cost exchanges are allowed. The exact all-positive-coupling phase classification identifies a nontrivial global entropy maximum at equal positive couplings (rate 1.8023925656), contrasting with the kinetic M-state census from the same physical model. At the half-coupling boundary only a two-state even-ring correction occurs and entropy does not change. This meaningful distinction separates finite exceptional cycles from exponentially abundant neutral-motif minima. The claim explicitly excludes r=0 as prior territory, fixed magnetization, and relaxation dynamics.
